questions.q: Where to find the code and key?
questions.a: On all official SARI Système SARL documents: invoices, quotes, certificates, product labels. The code follows the format SARI-XXX##-#####.

questions.q: What does the code format mean?
questions.a: SARI (company prefix) + Type code (FAC, DVV, etc.) + Year + Sequence number. Ex: SARI-FAC24-00001 = Invoice 2024 #00001.

questions.q: What to do if the document is not recognized?
questions.a: Contact our support immediately. It could be a forgery or an entry error.
'Revoked' means the document was cancelled by us (e.g., cancelled order). 'Invalid' means the document was reported as forged or altered.

questions.q: How long do documents remain valid?
questions.a: Invoices and quotes are valid indefinitely. Certificates have a variable validity period (1 to 5 years depending on the type).

legal.title: Legal Notice and Authenticity
legal.intro: The SARI Système SARL authenticity verification system guarantees the origin and validity of all official documents and products issued by our company. Each document contains a unique code in the format
legal.andKey: and an encrypted verification key allowing instant authentication.
legal.legalValueDesc: Documents verified as authentic by this system have full legal and commercial value under current Algerian legislation. In case of dispute, the positive verification result is proof of the document's authenticity before competent jurisdictions.
legal.antiCounterfeitDesc: SARI Système SARL is actively committed to fighting the counterfeiting of documents and medical products. Any document not recognized or reported as forged by our verification system must be considered suspicious and reported to our services as well as to the competent authorities.
legal.dataProtectionDesc: Verification information is processed confidentially and is not stored beyond the verification session. In accordance with
legal.lawDesc: relating to the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data, no personal data is retained during the verification process.
legal.warningDesc: Forgery of official documents is an offense punishable by criminal prosecution under the Algerian Penal Code (Articles 214, 217 and 147). If in doubt about the authenticity of a document, contact our services immediately or the competent judicial authorities.
